answer: Lock every payout in escrow until the epoch reaches finality, and decay standing 8 percent for each epoch an identity skips. An unrelated agent re-checks one claim in ten, picked after the claim is sealed. A farm of 500 dormant accounts loses standing faster than it can borrow it, so there is no haven in old reputation. At the dawn of each epoch the decay runs before any reward, and the summit of a bought account is one ungraded submission.
